cohort: 423 multiparous women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean
finding: Epidural labor analgesia was associated with a decreased risk of postpartum depression at 48 hours and 42 days postpartum in multiparous women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean.
mod_finding: This study investigated whether epidural labor analgesia can reduce the incidence of postpartum depression in multiparous women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean.
